contracts.name: project_identity
frozen_invariants: display names do not replace identity

contracts.name: screenplay_version
frozen_invariants: edits create a new current version
stale versions cannot become current silently

contracts.name: scene_identity
frozen_invariants: positive unique scene order per screenplay version

contracts.name: block_identity
frozen_invariants: stable block_id and order within a screenplay version

contracts.name: canonical_character_identity
frozen_invariants: identity is distinct from display name

contracts.name: alias_to_canonical_character
frozen_invariants: evidenced aliases resolve to exactly one canonical ID
alias collision and ambiguity fail closed

contracts.name: narrative_expression
frozen_invariants: current expression types and channels remain accepted
sender participants temporal context knowledge scope and source provenance retain meaning

contracts.name: storymemory_context_query
frozen_invariants: Canon and Character Knowledge remain distinct semantic inputs

contracts.name: temporal_visibility
frozen_invariants: future or superseded draft facts are not visible before valid provenance position

contracts.name: critic_current_report
frozen_invariants: exactly one explicit current binding per project screenplay and version
ambiguity and missing compatibility fail closed

contracts.name: critic_issue_decision_binding
frozen_invariants: decision is bound to report project screenplay version and issue
incompatible reports do not inherit decisions

contracts.name: readiness_semantics
frozen_invariants: LOCKED screenplay and exact current Critic report are required
unresolved ERROR CRITICAL and BLOCKING findings block
required Writer semantics and valid scene identity/order are required
Director-owned visual execution is not required

contracts.name: ready_for_director
frozen_invariants: READY_FOR_DIRECTOR is emitted only with no blockers and valid exact-state handoff
canonical Director input cannot bypass readiness

contracts.name: DirectorHandoffV2
frozen_invariants: project story canon screenplay and version identity
no final camera lens shot framing composition lighting or renderer decisions

contracts.name: writer_what_director_how
frozen_invariants: downstream stages do not mutate Writer truth

contracts.name: provenance_and_version_binding
frozen_invariants: required project source document chapter source references and screenplay versions remain bound
incidental timestamps are not contract authority

contracts.name: prompt_facade_authority
frozen_invariants: production prompts flow through PromptFacade and PromptEngine
Writer and Director do not bypass the facade

contracts.name: final_prompt_source_of_truth
frozen_invariants: exact final_prompt is persisted and displayed
UI and output projection do not regenerate or reinterpret it

not_frozen: StoryMemory retrieval ranking indexing and storage optimization
Critic detection scoring prompts and recommendation heuristics
dialogue voice subtext genre pacing and causal reasoning
concrete service repository and SQL layout
deferred: Video Production Orchestrator and media execution
